articles.summary: 2025 marks Schick’s 65th anniversary in Japan. Earlier this year, Schick Japan launched Progista, the first premium total grooming care brand for men endorsed by professionals, offering a one-stop solution that covers pre-shave skin protection, razor, and after-shave skin care...
articles.title: Progista: How Schick Japan Launched the First Total Grooming Care Brand for Men
